title:
Abstract base type for a {@link PkgInference.Transformer} that replaces a single {@link Workflow.Action} vertex with
another vertex. Depending on the context, dispatches to replacementFromOneParent or replacementFromTwoParents method
overridden and implemented by subtypes.
